violations.title: Food Packaged, Labeled per Law
violations.observation: Food packaged in the establishment is not labeled in accordance with Law. The following self-service food items which are made in the establishment or purchased and re-packaged in the establishment were not labeled: brownies, blondies, muffins and other baked goods on the counter, as well as chicken Caesar salad, pasta salad, potato salad, cous cous salad, chef’s salad, yogurt parfaits, cakes and pies in the self-service refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food packaged in a food establishment shall be labeled as specified in Law including 21 CFR 101 - Food labeling, and 9 CFR 317 Labeling, marking devices, and containers. Food packaged in a food establishment for customer self service shall include labels that contain the following information: 1. the common name of the food, 2. the list of major ingredients including artificial colors or preservatives, 3. the total net weight or quantity of the food, 4. the name and place of business of the food manufacturer, packer, or distributor, 5. the name of the food source for each major food allergen contained in the food, 6. nutrition labeling and, 7. for any salmonid fish containing canthaxanthin as a color additive, the labeling of the bulk fish container, including a list of ingredients, displayed on the retail container or by other written means. Label all these foods with all the required information listed above so that customers know the ingredients in case they have allergies or food sensitivities. Include an expiration date on the label. Label the outside of each individual item, or create one label and place it in front of the foods so customers can reference it as needed. Correct as soon as possible or within 30 days. A follow-up will be conducted to check on the correction of this repeat violation.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: the food manager emptied a round stainless steel container of chili into shallow pans to cool it properly. After emptying, he washed and rinsed the cylinder, but did not sanitize it.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. The environmental health specialist discussed this with the CFM. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: individual containers of pasta salad, potato salad, chicken on the chicken Caesar salad, and kale salad with temperatures of 44º, 44º, 45º, and 45º, respectively were out of temperature in the self-service display case.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The manager was advised to move the products further back in the display case to keep them cold. The out of temperature products were discarded. CDI.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: there were several ready to eat foods in refrigerators that had exceeded the dates on their date marking labels. They included a large container or pico de gallo with a date of 1/20/26 (expired 1/26/26 - 2 days ago), a container of beef stew with a date or 1/16/26 (expired 1/22/26 - 7 days ago), and a container of cooked chorizo with a date of 1/9/26 (expired 1/15/26 - 8 days ago).
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. The manager discarded all the products. The EHD provided the manager with a handout that details date marking requirements. CDI.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: a large, round stainless steel container of chili stored covered in the walk- in was 128º.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. The manager moved the chili to three uncovered shallow inserts to facilitate cooling. CDI.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: It took the manager a long time to find a food thermometer and when he did find a battery operated one, it did not work.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. The manager found another non-battery operated thermometer after another search. CDI.

violations.title: Food Packaged, Label Information
violations.observation: Several foods prepared and packaged in the establishment and being offered at the self-service refrigerator are not being labeled. This included chicken Caesar salad, potato salad, pasta salad, and kale salad.
violations.corrective_action: Food packaged in a food establishment for customer self service shall include labels that contain the following information: 1. the common name of the food, 2. the list of major ingredients including artificial colors or preservatives, 3. the total net weight or quantity of the food, 4. the name and place of business of the food manufacturer, packer, or distributor, 5. the name of the food source for each major food allergen contained in the food,6. nutrition labeling and, 7. for any salmonid fish containing canthaxanthin as a color additive, the labeling of the bulk fish container, including a list of ingredients, displayed on the retail container or by other written means. All foods prepared and packaged in the establishment must be labeled so consumers know what they are, what the ingredients are, and when it was prepared or expires.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Observed several fruit or drain flies in the back storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. The manager provided pest control invoices and is working to control the flies. CDI.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Cases of potato chips and a large bag of potatoes were stored on the floor in the back storage room. There were also cases of vita coca, Celsius, and bottled water stored on the floor in another storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: in use knives were being stored in the gaps between adjacent refrigerators.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The EHS discussed this with the manager. CDI.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean cardboard take-out containers at the front counter were not stored inverted to protect from contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. The manager inverted the containers during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: cooked onions on the top of fryer.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC was trained on time as a Public Health Control procedure and records. PIC placed time marking on container of cooked onions.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw shell eggs above chicken salad, tuna salad, potato salad in walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC placed raw shell eggs under aforementioned salads.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): half&half on counter in service area and cooked onions on the top of fryer.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. PIC was provided and signed written procedures on Time as a Public Health Control.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored in a sanitizer bucket with chlorine concentration <10ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC added chlorine into the solution to reach 100ppm
